messages:
customer-ops: Heads up — customer 'AcmeFin' reporting anomalous outbound traffic from their Redwood Private instance. They see frequent POSTs to external hosts, suspect possible data exfil. Logs attached (small payloads). Can someone triage?

morgan: On it. Opening incident and escalating. Can you paste time window + any suspicious IPs? Also confirm whether they use our managed KMS or BYOK.

customer-ops: Time window: 2024-04-02T14:02:00Z - 2024-04-02T14:18:00Z. IPs: 13.59.78.21, 34.201.9.102. Private env in eu-west-1, VPC peering to their VPC. They say egress was allowed via customer-managed NAT.

morgan: Escalating to sec-oncall — @ida please take.

ida: :eyes: Taking lead. Immediate triage checklist: 1) block egress for that env, 2) pull control-plane audit for key ops, 3) check KMS Decrypt events (CloudTrail), 4) rotate any suspected API keys. Running initial queries now.

sec-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2024-198 created; severity: P1; responders: ida, morgan, alex.s.

alex.s: I'll query VPC flow logs and host mapping. Running: 
```bash
# example query
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/vpc/flow --start-time 1712140000000 --end-time 1712142000000 --filter-pattern '13.59.78.21'
```

alex.s: Found repeated POSTs to 13.59.78.21 from pod redwood-worker-3 on node rwd-priv-23. Small payloads, high frequency. No large model weight transfers. Could be creds or metadata exfil.

ida: Check control-plane audit: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/audit?env=acmefin-private&start=2024-04-02T14:00:00Z&end=2024-04-02T15:00:00Z" | jq .events
```
Look for events with type: "Decrypt", "GetSecretValue", or unexpected 'CreateToken' ops. Also check for service account usage patterns.

morgan: Customer asked for immediate containment we can take without full signed paperwork — we can disable external egress for the private env and rotate platform API tokens. Do we have verbal approval?

jaya: Customer on the call now, they verbally approved disabling egress and rotating keys. Scheduling a deep-dive in 30m.

alex.s: Egress blocked at security-group level for env acmefin-private. Confirmed outbound to 13.59.78.21 stopped (checked flow logs). Also revoked one compromised API key (key-id: ak-78c9).

ida: KMS audit shows Decrypt by service account 'sa-acmefin-ingest' at 2024-04-02T14:05:12Z using key alias 'acmefin-data-key'. Sequence: Decrypt -> short HTTP POSTs -> further Decrypts. Suggest immediate key rotation + tighten IAM condition on the key to restrict principals and source VPC.

morgan: Action list for customer: 1) rotate KMS key + re-encrypt sensitive data, 2) issue new API creds and revoke old, 3) audit storage (S3/GCS) for suspicious objects, 4) provide full log export. I'll coordinate and share timeline.

customer-ops: Can you confirm whether model artifacts or prompt content left the cluster? They're concerned about PII.

alex.s: S3 access logs show no large downloads or model artifact transfers. The POSTs contain small JSON blobs — likely metadata or credentials. We're pulling payload samples now and will redact before sharing.

ida: Containment complete for now. Post-incident next steps I'm assigning: add detection rule for combined KMS Decrypt + external egress within 5 minutes, add RBAC checklist item for Private deployments to enforce KMS IAM conditions, and update the playbook with faster network-isolate steps. I'll open GH issue and link to INC-2024-198.

morgan: :thumbsup: Filing follow-ups, will share a detailed timeline and sanitized logs with AcmeFin. Extending audit log retention for this customer to 90 days per their request.

customer-ops: Appreciate the quick response. We'll surface any additional artifacts if we find them. Please keep us updated and share the root cause timeline when available.

eng-deploy-bot: Deploy rollback blocked for acmefin-private (safety hold) — manual approval required.

ida: Closing loop for now — initial containment successful, further analysis ongoing. Will post a concise incident summary + recommended mitigations within 24 hours.
